snippet.title: Wrong Elevator - Official Game Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wrong Elevator is a horror game about scavenging loot to maintain and upgrade the Elevator. Enter the elevator, explore eerie floors, collect items, avoid hostile entities, and descend deeper. There are no checkpoints. Explore, collect, hide, die, adapt, repeat. 👁️

WISHLIST IT NOW ON STEAM ►► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2875530/Wrong_Elevator/
